mcqs.question: With reference to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, which of the following is correct?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy was established in 1992, and Pralhad Joshi is its Minister. The other options incorrectly alter the establishment year, the minister, or both.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and the ISEA programme?
options: C-DAC was established in 1988 at Pune, and the ISEA programme was launched in 2005.
C-DAC was established in 1992 at Pune, and the ISEA programme was launched in 2005.
C-DAC was established in 1988 at Pune, and the ISEA programme was launched in 2010.
C-DAC was established in 1988 at Mumbai, and the ISEA programme was launched in 2005.
mcqs.explanation: C-DAC was established in 1988 at Pune, and the ISEA programme was launched in 2005. The other options change either the establishment year, the location, or the launch year.
